_note: The five generic Coaches' Voice club-admin articles on Freshdesk, plus the callouts support ends up repeating to every club. Shared across partners — if an article ID changes, change it here.

setup.td: Club name, timezone, brand colours and logo.

invite.td: Invite one by one or by CSV, set roles, resend or remove an invitation, and see how many of your seats are used.

content.td: Build a module and its units, then get it onto your coaches’ home page.

announcements.td: The message that greets coaches when they log in. Useful in induction week.

reporting.td: Seat usage, CPD progress and per-coach activity, with an export.

sessionPlannerHelp.td: Every guide for the tool itself. Log in to Session Planner first.

coachTour.td: Rather watch than read? The same ground, in two minutes.

gettingStarted.td: Click through the real screens with the next thing to press highlighted each time.

callouts.whereYouWork: Everything below happens in Club Settings. Click your initials at the top right of the platform and choose it — that opens the admin area with its own sidebar down the left. Coaches never see any of it.
callouts.publishedNotVisible: A module set to Published is not necessarily visible. It appears for coaches once it sits in a content rail that is itself published. If a coach says they cannot find something you just published, that is almost always why.
callouts.referenceNoProgress: Reference material does not show up as progress. A coach can live in reference content all season and it will not move a single number, by design. Only completed units count. Judge engagement on the modules you set, not on the reference maps.
